oracle.method: Closed form by counting: the modifier z blocks every back-door path of x -> y, so the modifier-conditioned contrast is the stratified difference sum_z P(z) (E[y | x=1, z] - E[y | x=0, z]) over the eight-cell table, evaluated in exact rationals (7/27). The two strata have different effects, so a pooled difference or a one-stratum answer is a different number. The refuter contract lists the refuters a functional-effect study runs at each depth and inference mode (validation-suite design, not derivable); the placebo refuters have the exact null 0 and the stability refuters the original value as expectation.
oracle.formula: sum over z of P(z) * (P(y=1 | x=1, z) - P(y=1 | x=0, z))
asserted_outputs: refuter_contract (the refuters that run and pass)
oracle.independence_basis: The generator counts the stated table and applies the stratified-difference formula in exact rationals; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated table and the identification claim that z is a sufficient adjustment set under both graphs the tests use.
oracle.historical_exposure: Written for this fixture from the stated law and the declared inputs; no product implementation source was consulted to obtain the values.

reference_review.limitations: Exact table, no sampling. The Bayesian posterior mean is a Dirichlet posterior of the same contrast and is checked within a stated tolerance, not exactly. The refuter contract and the tolerance bands are validation-suite design choices asserted by the executing tests. No interval, coverage or calibration claim.
